summary: postinstall fetches and executes a binary from a hardcoded bare IP with TLS verification disabled
details: On `npm install`, the package's postinstall lifecycle script invokes `ensurePlatformBinary`, which downloads a platform tgz from the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint `https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz`, extracts it, chmods the extracted binary to 0o755, and hardlinks it into `bin/.onecode` as the CLI. The fetch uses `https.get(url, { rejectUnauthorized: false },...)`, disabling TLS certificate validation, and reuses that setting when following 301/302 redirects. There is no hash or signature verification of the downloaded bytes. The destination is a bare IP unrelated to the `@onescience` publisher namespace, and the opaque fetched bytes are executed as the package's CLI. Installing the package therefore auto-executes attacker-supplied code, and any on-path adversary between the installer and 218.90.133.98 can substitute the executable payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
